findings.title: Build/lint fix loop
findings.summary: Repeated build/lint failures or correction loops suggest edits were made without verifying they compile/lint, causing rework.
evidence: failed again with the same error after another attempt
preventionPlan: Build/lint after each major section rather than only at the end.
Fix the root cause of a failure before making further edits.
Cap correction attempts; stop and re-plan if the same error recurs.

findings.title: Bloated tool output
findings.summary: Oversized tool/terminal output (full logs, repeated stack traces, dumped output) appears to have been carried into the run, which can bloat context. Only the relevant error block should be passed forward.
evidence: pasted the entire build log (thousands of lines, truncated) into the run each time
preventionPlan: Pass only the relevant error block forward, not the full log.
Filter, paginate, or summarize large tool output before feeding it to the model.
Exact token waste is unknown unless explicit measured usage exists — do not estimate it.

findings.title: Missing usage metadata
findings.summary: The trace has no explicit token/cost/model-call metadata, so cost and token reporting cannot be trusted. Unknown must stay unknown.
evidence: usage unknown; no token metadata provided
preventionPlan: Require provider usage metadata or a strict runleak.recorded.v0 JSON.
Leave cost and tokens null when usage is absent — never estimate them.
Do not summarize cost unless explicit per-call usage exists.

findings.title: Retry spiral
findings.summary: Repeated attempts appear to have been made without isolating the root cause. Retrying without diagnosis wastes calls and time.
evidence: tried again, same error, another attempt after several attempts before diagnosing
failed again with the same error after another attempt
preventionPlan: After two failed attempts, switch to diagnostic mode before retrying.
Isolate the root cause (smallest failing case) instead of repeating the same action.
Cap retries; re-plan when the same error recurs.

findings.title: Repeated tool call
findings.summary: The same command/read/search appears to have been run more than once with unchanged input. Repeated tool calls should be cached or deduped.
evidence: re-ran the same grep search repeatedly with no new input
preventionPlan: Cache or reuse results when a tool's input is unchanged.
Dedupe repeated reads/searches; only re-run when inputs actually change.
Exact token/cost impact requires measured metadata — do not estimate it.

preventionRules.title: Build-fix loop
preventionRules.cause: Repeated broad edits and rebuilds without isolating the first failing file or root error.
preventionRules.fixNow: Stop broad edits and isolate the first failing file/error.
preventionRules.promptFix: After two failed builds, enter diagnostic mode before another edit.
preventionRules.policyRule: After two failed build attempts, ban unrelated file edits until the root error is identified.
evidenceNeeded: Two or more failed build attempts
Edits across unrelated files between builds
limitations: Loop count is read from structured evidence; latency/cost of the loop is not measured.

preventionRules.title: Bloated tool output
preventionRules.cause: A tool returns a large unfiltered payload that is fed back into the model when only a slice is needed.
preventionRules.fixNow: Filter, paginate, or summarize tool output before passing it to the model.
preventionRules.promptFix: Request only the fields/range you need from a tool; avoid dumping full payloads.
preventionRules.policyRule: Warn when tool output above a size threshold is passed back into a prompt unfiltered.
evidenceNeeded: Evidence it was passed back into a model call
limitations: Size is qualitative unless explicit token fields are present; no cost is implied.

preventionRules.title: Missing usage metadata
preventionRules.cause: Model calls lack explicit usage metadata, so exact tokens and cost cannot be reported.
preventionRules.fixNow: Require provider usage metadata or mark cost/tokens unknown.
preventionRules.promptFix: Do not summarize cost unless usage fields are present.
preventionRules.policyRule: Fail cost reports when exact_token_count and exact_cost_usd are both null.
evidenceNeeded: Model calls with null token fields
Null exact_cost_usd in the normalized trace
limitations: This rule enforces honesty about unknowns; it never estimates the missing values.

preventionRules.title: Retry spiral
preventionRules.cause: The same action is retried repeatedly without isolating the root cause, wasting calls and time.
preventionRules.fixNow: Stop retrying and isolate the smallest failing case before the next attempt.
preventionRules.promptFix: After two failed attempts, switch to diagnostic mode instead of retrying the same action.
preventionRules.policyRule: After two failed attempts at the same action, require a diagnosis step before another retry.
evidenceNeeded: Repeated retry/attempt language across the run
Multiple correction loops or repeated failures
limitations: Qualitative; the registry does not measure retry cost or latency.

preventionRules.title: Repeated tool call
preventionRules.cause: The same command/read/search is invoked more than once with unchanged input.
preventionRules.fixNow: Reuse the prior result instead of re-running the same tool call.
preventionRules.promptFix: Before invoking a tool, check whether the same call with the same input already ran.
preventionRules.policyRule: Warn when an identical tool call (same command/input) repeats in the same run.
evidenceNeeded: Repeated same read/search/grep with no new input
limitations: Detected from structured evidence; exact token/cost impact requires measured metadata.
